# TI TMS9900

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from `crates/isa/src/tms9900.rs`. Edits here are overwritten; change the spec instead. -->

69 instructions, words big-endian. Generated from [`crates/isa/src/tms9900.rs`](https://github.com/asm198x/asm198x/blob/main/crates/isa/src/tms9900.rs).

This CPU encodes an instruction as an opcode **word** whose operand fields are bits inside it, so there is no opcode-then-operands table to give. Each instruction has a *base* — the opcode word with its operand fields zeroed — and a *class* saying where those fields sit.

## Classes

| Class | Encoding | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ImmReg` | `base \| W` | Format VIII — workspace register plus an immediate word |
| `StoreReg` | `base \| W` | Format VIII — store into a workspace register |
| `ImmOnly` | `base` | Format VIII — an immediate word, no register |
| `Control` | `base` | Format VII — no operand, fixed opcode |
| `SingleGeneral` | `base \| Ts&lt;&lt;4 \| S` | Format VI — one general operand |
| `Shift` | `base \| count&lt;&lt;4 \| W` | Format V — workspace register, shift count 0–15 |
| `Jump` | `base \| (off &amp; 0xFF)` | Format II jump — word-scaled PC-relative |
| `Cru` | `base \| (disp &amp; 0xFF)` | Format II CRU-bit — signed CRU offset |
| `DualRegDst` | `base \| D&lt;&lt;6 \| Ts&lt;&lt;4 \| S` | Format III/IX — general source, register destination |
| `Xop` | `base \| D&lt;&lt;6 \| Ts&lt;&lt;4 \| S` | Format IX XOP — general source, XOP number 0–15 |
| `CruMulti` | `base \| (count &amp; 0xF)&lt;&lt;6 \| Ts&lt;&lt;4 \| S` | Format IV — general source, CRU bit count 1–16 |
| `DualGeneral` | `base \| Td&lt;&lt;10 \| D&lt;&lt;6 \| Ts&lt;&lt;4 \| S` | Format I — two general operands |

## Provenance

This specification was authored from the following, in the family's primary reference library:

- *TMS9900 Microprocessor Data Manual* — Texas Instruments, 1976 (`by-topic/cpu-tms9900/`)

Not from any emulator's decode loop: an emulator is a reading of the hardware, and this is meant to be a reading of the documentation.
